decisions.prior_evidence: Decision 2026-10-01: WATCHLIST, not entry. Latest verified LME reference available to this cycle: USD 14,740/t (Sep 28). decisions.prior_evidence: Preserved official RFP/amendment findings: one new UPS >=15 kW, 208V/60Hz three-phase input/output, >=5 minutes at full load, batteries included, <=250 kg, maximum 60 x 100 x 170 cm, BCS-815-compatible signal converter, Canadian electrical approval; lowest-price compliant award. CanadaBuys still lists 2026-10-06 close. New product screening: Schneider's GVSUPS20KB4FS page confirms a 20 kW/208V unit with two internal strings, but does not prove total installed weight or >=5-minute runtime within NRC limits. Schneider's official mechanical table lists the 15–25 kW 208V three-string configuration at 680 kg and 197 cm high, failing both hard limits; each module is about 32 kg. Eaton 93PM 208V supports the electrical requirement, but Eaton lists 74 in / 188 cm height, above the 170 cm limit. No exact configuration is documented as compliant across power, runtime, total weight, dimensions and converter compatibility; no written Canadian quote or landed margin exists.
